ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low; the visible surface area consists of approximately 95% low-intensity (dark grey/black) pixels and 5% high-intensity (white/light grey) focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark pigmentation across the entire visible ventral field, punctuated by small, discrete high-contrast circular blobs (approx. 8-12 pixels wide) distributed sparsely across the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; calculated angle of approximately 22 degrees with a sharp vertex at the central convergence of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-amplitude, non-uniform jagged serrations; the right lobe trailing edge contains three primary macro-concavities (notches) followed by high-frequency micro-peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primary convex sweep; significantly disrupted on the right lobe by a major non-linear truncation (tissue loss) on the superior-lateral margin.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detected clusters of high-contrast white pixels forming roughly circular patterns; four clusters are visible on the mid-left lobe and three on the mid-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertical low-contrast linear disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the mid-to-lower portion of the left fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive traumatic tissue loss on the upper-lateral margin of the right lobe (large jagged notch) and extreme irregular serration along the entire posterior boundary consistent with historical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique multi-tiered jagged indentation pattern on the upper-right fluke tip that breaks the expected smooth curve of the leading edge.
